notes.title: Steam Achievements
notes.content:
Steam achievements have been added to the game. 15 varied and challenging achievements are available to test your skills:

Stealthy: Complete a level without alerting anyone on hard difficulty.

Zero Deaths: Complete a level without dying on hard difficulty.

Floor Is Lava: Do seven consecutive walljumps.

Flying Menace: Kill two enemies while airbourne.

Trapper: Kill an enemy with a laser trap.

X-Man: Throw a camera up on the X in Trust.

Gotta Go Fast: Reach a horizontal speed of 14 m/s.

Four For Four: Kill 4 enemies within 4 seconds.

Sharpshooter: Kill an enemy from a distance of 50 meters.

Saving A Friend: Find the secret zone in Core.

Secret Stash: Find the hidden ammo refill in Core's last zone.

Are You Winning Son?: Complete the game on hard difficulty.

Knife To A Gunfight: Complete a level using only your knife on hard difficulty.

Ghost: Clear a zone without killing anyone by disabling all enemy transmitters on hard difficulty.

Speed Demon: Complete a level within two minutes on hard difficulty.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2022-12-22
notes.content:
- Added easy and normal difficulties that can be accessed when starting a new game and through the options menu. Difficulty affects number of enemies, platforming sections and ai behavior such as awareness and reaction time.

- Improved knife attack collision

- Changed sonar scan to be cooldown based.

- Added Esc key mapping to credit screen.

notes.title: Update Notes 2 for 2022-12-03
notes.content: - Fix zone not saving when skipping zone.

notes.title: Update Notes for 2022-12-03
notes.content:
- Added options to skip zone.
- Increased story message time.
- Added Esc key to credits exit.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Latest tweaks and updates:

- Exit marker on radar after killing last enemy.
- Easier walljump in tutorial.
- Remain crouched after jumping.
- Extra knife collision box for wider close hits.
- Reduced gun recoil.
- Random spawns off by default.
- Longer story timers.
- Larger jumppad platforms.
- Option to disable reticle.
- Option to disable weapon visuals.
- Vertical hits at speed in air will trigger knife attack.
- Juicier sound for knifehit and knifedraw.
- Stats displayed on pause and game over screens.
- Radar blip distance adjusts for on field of view.
- Default install borderless to avoid green flicker on some graphics cards.

notes.title: Content Update
notes.content:
Here are the latest additions to the game:

- Checkpoint system for parkour sections.
- Sonar Scan ability that allows a quick scan of your enemies positions.
- Instant retries.
- New combat area on Volcano.
- Reworked parkour section on Core.
- Reworked final room.
- Alerts and other stats visible on Pause screen.
